UserAvatarPreferences.title: UserAvatarPreferences
UserAvatarPreferences.description: Stores Pauline's persisted mood and backdrop color preferences for the authenticated user.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single message in the user's conversation with Pauline.

moodTag.description: Avatar mood associated with the message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

MemoryItem.title: MemoryItem
MemoryItem.description: A real persistent memory about the user remembered by Pauline across conversations.

source.description: Whether the memory was learned in conversation or added manually.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the memory was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}/memories/{memoryId}.description: User-scoped real memories remembered by Pauline.
